title: Stones·ThePathOfAThousandRocks
description:
It is my first map in this place.
Preface:
Thousands of rocks,hear the name of the travellers,
You should be awake,let them start their own journey.
All the travellers,you should be like the stones,
Keeping silent in front of the vanity.
Let your journey begin,travellers,
Challenge the unknown with your own serenity.
